lines.text: Hi! Are you free on June 14th for our wedding?
Thank you. For. Your. Inquiry. We will respond. In three. To five. Business days.
Congratulations! June 14th is open. Here are our wedding packages, and a link to book a quick call this week.
Same inquiry. Two very different replies. Which one gets booked?
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Send this to a photographer friend. You're still the captain.
